increment_paragraph: **LINK-STANDING** (round 28, rule 40; implements the user's "Option A (rec.)" on BODY-SUMMARY-REUSE-LINK-STANDING and, for Monkey, "Analyse linked config" (2026-11-08); [report](../../reports/link-standing/README.md)). With `QCORE_CROSS_UNIT_LINK_RESOLUTION` naming a `quirin-link-resolution/1` artifact (`prepare --link`), the `current` route adopts the artifact's homes as rule 4c's resolution instead of a stated map; rule 4c's export, census, scope, replay budget and two-sided replay are unchanged. Fifteen ordered conditions, each failing closed to the uncontracted call with a named reason: (run) the artifact's compile-database digest equals the route's and every bound digest (executable, link command, map, driver, linker, every linked input) verifies; (caller) its configuration is linked and reproduced; (home) an executable image, defined in it, strong global function, default visibility, the only linked definition, no dynamic relocation, no artifact-level fact refusal, a linked reproduced configuration that the route analyses under a `library/file` key naming it alone (the artifact's route-relative refusals are re-decided on the route's own configurations); (caller) Clang's type of the callee in both units, equal: every declaration at file scope with one spelling, a `typeof` probe's type tree rendered without sugar and parameter qualifiers, prototype attributes kept, and named records' canonical layouts equal where both units complete them (`link_call_type.rs`). No rule names Monkey: on this base its callers fail the linked-caller condition and its homes the analysed-configuration condition; CURRENT-MONKEY-LINKED-CONFIGURATION makes them derivable with no rule change. The assumption names the artifact as derived evidence (digests, refusals by reason, each home's definition record) and states no premise; the artifact digest is the link identity rule 4c binds. A pinned route refuses the option. Lean `QCore.CrossUnitSummary` extended (`standing`, a refusal theorem per condition, `typeAgrees_iff`, `derived_resolution_discharges`, `derived_refusal_is_not_admitted`, `refused_home_supplies_nothing`, `standing_vectors_hold`). Prediction: none on corpus, system and slice; on `current` with the artifact at most 14 Unknown->Safe (5 sole-blocked), Monkey rows unchanged.

ledger.why: DISCHARGED (LINK-STANDING, round 28, base a0ac2cae9, tip 1f04fb45a): the user's Option A is implemented as rule 40. The current route derives rule 4c's resolution from a supplied link-resolution artifact under checked conditions (database and bound digests, linked caller configuration, one strong default-visibility executable definition from a linked, reproduced configuration the route analyses under a unique key, no dynamic relocation, equal Clang call type with equal canonical record layouts); each failure leaves the call uncontracted with its reason; the assumption names the artifact as derived evidence, not a premise. Lean QCore.CrossUnitSummary extended with the derived resolution and its refusals. Predicted on current with the artifact: at most 14 Unknown->Safe, including 5 of the 7 cross-unit sole-blocked functions (ctxTypeID_to_size, cio_chunk_hash, cio_chunk_is_up, rd_kafka_share_consumer_closed_err, rd_kafka_transport_ssl_threadid_cb); mk_mq_send and net_plain_writev stay blocked by Monkey homes until CURRENT-MONKEY-LINKED-CONFIGURATION. The integrator measures and reruns current with the artifact.

ledger.text: AMENDED (LINK-STANDING, rule 40): no rule names Monkey. On the current route's base, a Monkey caller fails rule 40's linked-caller condition (its libevent configuration is not a linked configuration of the artifact) and a Monkey home fails the analysed-configuration condition (the route does not analyse the linked lib/monkey configuration). Once the route analyses lib/monkey under Fluent Bit's own, linked configuration (user decision 2026-11-08, "Analyse linked config"), both conditions hold with no change to rule 40, and the 24 callees (55 sites, blockers of mk_mq_send and net_plain_writev) are decided like every other home.

ledger.title: Rule 40's call-type check compares records reached through a member pointer by tag only
ledger.text: Rule 40 (LINK-STANDING) compares a cross-unit callee's canonical signature and, for each tagged record the signature names, Clang's canonical layout where both units complete it. A record reached only through a member pointer of such a record is compared by tag alone, and enumeration constants are not compared, so two units whose same-tag definitions differ one pointer level down would still agree (an incompatible-type call the C standard leaves undefined). DISCHARGE: a transitive layout comparison over every record reachable from the signature, or a DWARF cross-check of the home object's subprogram type against the caller's, with the measured refusals.
